hero.eyebrow: Standardized metaphysics knowledge for Vietnamese readers
hero.title: Bringing a thousand years of metaphysical knowledge closer to Vietnamese people.
hero.lead: La So Viet does not begin from vague psychology or fixed pronouncements about fate. We built a standardized knowledge platform that gathers the finest Eastern and Western divinatory disciplines, explained in plain, well-referenced, transparent Vietnamese — giving you the key to understand yourself and take charge of every turning point in life.

mission.title: Three things we do every day.

m1.title: Simplify & standardize
m1.body: Simplify a thousand years of Eastern and Western metaphysical knowledge into a structured, accurate, and accessible digital interpretation system.

m2.title: Plain, well-referenced Vietnamese
m2.body: Turn complex classical terminology into clear, modern language; every reading links back to a specific reference — nothing is claimed without a source.

m3.title: Understanding that leads to action
m3.body: Help Vietnamese readers see their strengths, weaknesses, and turning points in full, so they can prepare actively and stand steady through life.

vision.body: To become the leading digital knowledge and interpretation platform for Vietnamese metaphysics, setting a new standard of transparency, academic rigor, and ethics in self-discovery and fortune reading.

v1.title: Grounded & academic
v1.body: Every reading comes from precise star-placement algorithms, hexagram casting, and astronomical calculation. No emotional guesswork, no vague claims without a classical basis.

v2.title: Objective & consistent
v2.body: Data is standardized through a dedicated computation model, removing subjective psychology and inconsistency between lookups.

v3.title: Transparent & respectful
v3.body: No fear-mongering about fate, no exploiting anxiety to push superstitious rituals. Costs are public and clear from the start.

v4.title: Deeply personalized
v4.body: No generic templated readings. Every chart is broken down against your exact birth date and time and your real, current concern.

v5.title: Visual & empowering
v5.body: Turns complex diagrams into an intuitive, interactive interface; turns anxiety into a foothold for confident action.

disciplines.title: One lens is never enough.
disciplines.lead: La So Viet is not confined to a single discipline. We bring together humanity's finest divinatory frameworks for the most complete, multi-angle view.

tuvi.name: Ziwei Doushu (Purple Star Astrology)
tuvi.desc: A 12-palace destiny map that reveals core character, wealth, career, and the shifting decade cycles of your life.

batu.name: BaZi (Four Pillars)
batu.desc: Four pillars of Year, Month, Day, and Hour, reading the balance of the Five Elements and your rhythm of fortune over time.

chiemtinh.name: Western Astrology
chiemtinh.desc: A 12-house chart and planetary positions at the moment of birth, decoding deep psychological structure and inner drives.

kinhdich.name: I Ching
kinhdich.desc: A philosophical consultation tool for the moment, suggesting when to act and when to hold before an important decision.

thansohoc.name: Numerology
thansohoc.desc: The vibrational frequency of your name and birth date, shaping life lessons and the rhythm of your personal year cycles.

commitments.title: What we will never trade away.

c1.title: Academic grounding, always
c1.body: Every claim points to the principle behind it; nothing is judged on guesswork.

c2.title: Permanent privacy
c2.body: Birth date, time, and personal data are fully protected; anonymous user data is automatically purged after 24 hours.

c3.title: Ethical experience
c3.body: No fear tactics, no fake countdown timers, no inflated top-up exchange rates, no hidden fees.

c4.title: Companionship, not dependence
c4.body: A calm perspective that helps you understand yourself, instead of building dependence or fear of fate.

closing.quote: Fate is not a sentence handed down in advance — it is a map with many paths. La So Viet is here to help you light that map.
closing.ctaTitle: Your road ahead is ready to be seen clearly.
